assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Production background asset for a playable Chinese fantasy tabletop game UI. Create a SINGLE 16:9 landscape painted environment background, 2560x1440 if supported, with NO interface content at all. This is the empty physical play surface onto which real text, cards and buttons will be drawn separately.

View almost straight down at a wide substantial walnut campaign desk with a large rectangular deep petrol-teal woven fabric inset. Front-facing, symmetric usable play surface, only a slight suggestion of desk thickness at the very bottom. The entire central 84% width and central 82% height must be QUIET unobstructed teal fabric with softly mottled broad painterly shading, absolutely no objects, patterns, printed graphics or seams crossing the play area. The inset has a single deep recessed join and narrow occlusion shadow beneath a thick wooden surround. The outer wooden rim has visible broad bevels, warm endgrain at the bottom edge and rounded substantial corners, not thin gilded lines. A few plain brown-bronze fasteners at far corners only.

At the very far left edge, partially cropped out: one closed plain leather folio and the subdued base of a small amber lantern. At the far right bottom edge, one folded ivory map mostly outside the usable play surface. Keep these peripheral props small, dim, painterly and integrated into the tabletop. No large lantern in the central field, no scroll at center, no center logo. Top border can hint at dark timber room beyond but NO windows with bright landscapes. No other clutter.

Hand-painted fantasy game art with confident chunky volumes, generous softly lit planes and selective sharp edges. Warm walnut glows softly only on its upper-left-facing bevel, main bronze faces brown and rough, teal fabric light-absorbing, leather supple. Restrained grain serving material, NO dirt or scratches sprayed all over. Warm upper-left key light, cool soft fill. Center fabric should be readable medium-dark teal (#143d42 region), not black, not cyan neon. Peripheral framing lower contrast than future cards. Rich and inviting, sculptural and tactile, akin to carefully painted tabletop game props. No glossy 3D plastic, no photographic textures, no microscopic decorative carving, no gold filigree, no gems, no border glow.

Must contain NO cards, NO characters, NO icons, NO buttons, NO text, NO watermark. No chessboard or grid. Full-bleed opaque background. The clear space is essential for production UI.

Use case: ui-mockup. ONE reusable production game UI panel asset, square 1024x1024, orthographic perfectly front-facing. A substantial dark walnut frame around a large quiet inset dark brown leather surface. No perspective taper, left and right perfectly vertical and parallel, top and bottom horizontal. Outline is a rounded rectangle with gently squared broad corners. Frame occupies only the outer 9 percent on each side; central 82 percent is plain matte near-dark brown leather (#30251f approximately), uninterrupted, even, no decoration. Outside the rounded rectangle: genuinely transparent alpha, NOT white and NOT a checkerboard painting; leave just 20px outer padding.

Make the object convincingly thick using the cross-section: broad warm softly illuminated upper-left-facing walnut bevel, darker narrow inner recess with contact shadow, substantial dark lower/right side face, a tight soft contact shadow below. One broad frame only. Tiny plain aged-bronze corner fasteners recessed into the walnut, not bright ornaments. Main bronze faces brown with a single small directional glint. Wood has broad stylized painted grain, not photographic burl and not evenly sprayed noise. Surface maintained and warm, not dirty. Leather slightly supple with a broad soft tonal response, no patterned fabric or folds in the center.

Art direction: tactile hand-painted fantasy tabletop props, chunky sculpted forms with deliberate plane changes, strong material separation and clean silhouettes. Upper-left warm key light, restrained cool fill, no bloom. Clarity of form first. No gems, filigree, thin gold lines, spikes, text, symbols, characters, items, buttons, logos, watermark or example UI. No dramatic spotlight in the center. This texture will be 9-sliced in a real UI: all edge sections straight and uniform, corner details confined to the corners, the center visually calm and stretchable. Make a complete single asset, not a sheet or perspective mockup.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE production UI texture asset: a square thick cream parchment sheet for a fantasy game detail panel. 1024x1024 canvas. Perfectly front-facing, no tilted perspective. Genuinely transparent alpha OUTSIDE the sheet. Sheet takes 96% of canvas. Slightly irregular but mostly straight rectangular edges, tiny rolled upper-right corner, a substantial softly layered lower paper edge and delicate contact shadow. Broad warm ivory unprinted center covering at least 88% of the sheet; subtle diffuse surface variation, barely visible fibers, gentle cream edges. No brown stain field, no grunge, no dark patch in the center. Soft light from upper left. Confident hand-painted fantasy prop art, broad deliberate brush shapes and tactile volume, not photographic and not glossy plastic. The important feature is the flat clean bright reading surface with real edge thickness. Edges must be suitable for nine-slice resizing, irregularities small and confined to the margin. NO lettering, ink, diagrams, symbols, border line, runes, wax seal, pins, buttons, title, background, checkerboard painting or watermark. Only one blank parchment sheet.

Use case: ui-mockup. ONE production UI button asset on genuinely transparent alpha: a thick horizontal turquoise enamel press-piece seated in a simple dark aged bronze socket. Canvas 1536x512, the complete button spans 94% width and 76% height centered, ample transparent outside margin. Perfect orthographic front view, all long edges horizontal and parallel. Shape is a long rectangular lozenge with short 45-degree chamfered corners, not a capsule. Broad visibly thick bevel faces, dark underside about 12% of button height, narrow contact shadow below. Rich deep petrol turquoise central enamel (#126275) with two broad quietly shaded facets; large uninterrupted blank center. Only ONE broad bronze perimeter, predominantly brown matte metal, a warm narrow highlight along upper-left face; no additional gold outlines. A tiny controlled pale turquoise reflection at upper left of enamel, rest remains solid richly colored. Sculpted, hand-painted fantasy prop, large simple planes and intentional brush shading; restrained subtle surface texture. It must read as a substantial clickable object at small UI size. No text, symbols, icon, gems, spikes, runes, filigree, embossed design, neon glow or watermark. Do not add other states or example interface. Single complete asset.

Use case: ui-mockup. ONE production UI button asset on genuinely transparent alpha: a thick horizontal warm walnut press-piece with a simple deep brown bevelled edge. Canvas 1536x512, the complete button spans 94% width and 76% height centered, ample transparent outside margin. Perfect orthographic front view, all long edges horizontal and parallel. Shape is a long rectangular lozenge with short 45-degree chamfered corners, not a capsule. The same family as a chunky fantasy tabletop button. Broad softly rounded bevel faces, dark lower sidewall about 12% height, narrow contact shadow beneath. Large uninterrupted flat walnut center (#513423), quiet broad diffuse highlights from upper left, three or four restrained elongated painted grain shapes rather than photographic micrograin. Two tiny dark bronze pins near left and right end, no bright jewelry. Tactile stylized hand-painted game prop with sculpted mass and deliberately simplified planes, warm and well maintained, not dirty and not varnished plastic. No gold perimeter, no neon, no glowing edge, no text, lettering, symbols, gems, spikes, runes, engraved illustration, icon or watermark. Do not add other states or example interface. Single complete asset.
